newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: BIB to launch new Omani equity fund.
newsitem.headline: BIB to launch new Omani equity fund.

text.p: Bahrain International Bank E.C. (BIB) said on Tuesday it would launch a new fund that would primarily invest in new Omani stocks.

A BIB statement said The Muscat Special IPO Fund was jointly structured with Bank Muscat al-Ahli al-Omani to give investors a chance to take part in new company flotations in the booming Omani equity market.
Bahrain-based BIB, traded on the Bahraini and Omani bourses, said the fund was underwritten by Kuwait Investment Co, Bank Muscat and BIB and would be closed at $25 million.
It will actively trade newly listed stocks, and gains will be re-invested in the fund either in further initial public offerings or in existing stocks in the secondary market.

"Taking advantage of the extremely buoyant equity markets and the increasing number of company flotations in Oman, BIB's new fund will give investors a chance to participate in a broad range of new public offerings," managing director David Knights said.
The fund, which will not be listed, is to be closed with an operational life of 18 months but if a majority of the unitholders agree, the fund would become open-ended, he added.

Knight said the Gulf equity markets were "still quite restrictive, but we strongly believe that as these markets open up to foreign investors we will see a significant upsurge in interest from the major global institutions".
